name: Better Entity Reference simplytest.me demo
description: Applies the parent module's demo_content recipe on install, so an evaluation sandbox that can only enable a module lands with a ready-to-try BER demo content type.
project_description: A tiny submodule of Better Entity Reference whose only job is to apply the module's demo_content recipe from its hook_install, creating a 'BER demo' content type with one field per widget. Evaluation sandboxes such as simplytest.me can only enable a module (they cannot run 'drush recipe:apply'), so this module bridges that gap; the parent module's info.yml lists it under simplytest_dependencies so a sandbox enables it automatically. It creates no content and skips quietly (a status message) if the demo content type already exists. Meant for evaluation, not production.
